# Morning Star Sandalwood Japanese Incense Sticks: Six Boxes of 50 Sticks

## Traditional Japanese Craftsmanship

Morning Star has been one of Nippon Kodo's best-selling incense lines for over 40 years. Each box holds 50 premium incense sticks from Japan, and this set includes six boxes, so you have plenty on hand for daily use.

## Scents That Set the Mood

Blend sage, sandalwood, cedarwood, musk, frankincense, and myrrh into a warm, layered aroma. Sandalwood and cedarwood stand out most, while the softer notes add depth. Light a stick to create a calm, inviting atmosphere for your home or meditation space.

## Designed for Everyday Calm

Each stick burns for about 30 minutes and measures roughly 4.75 inches, making it easy to enjoy a short ritual between tasks, during a quiet evening, or as part of a mindful practice. The shorter length also suits anyone who wants a brief, fragrant moment rather than a longer burn.

## A Thoughtful Gift for Incense Lovers

Packaged in attractive boxes, this set makes a practical and considerate present for friends, family, or anyone who appreciates traditional Japanese fragrance.

## Find Your Scent Today

Bring a little tranquility into your routine. Add Morning Star Sandalwood Japanese Incense Sticks to your cart and discover a scent that fits your space.
